# Curation entry

- Fit the entry into the existing topic structure before creating a new category.
- State the problem class the algorithm or structure addresses.
- Record expected time and space complexity when well-defined.
- Link a canonical or high-quality reference.
- Avoid duplicate variants unless the tradeoff is educationally meaningful.
- Keep implementation claims language-neutral unless the repository section is language-specific.
